project_evidence.observed_boundary: The current primitive explicitly emits a processing-credit candidate rather than causal proof and exact-fences pair identity, generation, metric schema/direction and typed-memory identity. Repository CI is accepted at component scope; runtime, physical GRID10, causal-proof, transfer-validity and whole-system credit remain zero.

primary_sources.source: Meng, Bau, Andonian, Belinkov — Locating and Editing Factual Associations in GPT, NeurIPS 2022
primary_sources.observed: The paper uses explicit causal interventions to identify decisive activations, supporting intervention/lesion-rescue style evidence rather than correlation-only attribution.

primary_sources.source: Imai, Keele, Tingley — A General Approach to Causal Mediation Analysis, Psychological Methods 2010
primary_sources.observed: Causal mediation requires explicit definitions, identification assumptions, estimation and sensitivity analysis; observed association alone is insufficient for causal mechanism claims.

primary_sources.source: Sundararajan, Dhamdhere, Agarwal — The Shapley Taylor Interaction Index, ICML 2020
primary_sources.observed: Attribution can include interactions among subsets of features/components; additive single-component credit can therefore obscure interaction terms. This is an attribution framework, not by itself causal identification.

primary_sources.source: Kumar, Venkatasubramanian, Scheidegger, Friedler — Problems with Shapley-value-based explanations as feature importance measures, ICML 2020
primary_sources.observed: Shapley-style feature-importance explanations can require causal reasoning to match explanatory goals, reinforcing the boundary between mathematical allocation and causal explanation.

hypothesis: WP305 pairwise baseline/intervention deltas are appropriate descriptive processing-credit candidates, but promotion to causal method credit requires intervention identity plus controls that rule out confounding, stochastic variation and interaction-only explanations.
counterhypothesis: For a fully deterministic execution path with exact counterfactual substitution and all other inputs/environment/source identities fixed, a single matched intervention may be sufficient to establish a bounded local causal effect; replication/randomization is then unnecessary for that exact deterministic scope, though interaction and transfer claims remain separate.

minimum_causal_promotion_fields: interaction/co-intervention identity when multiple methods are active
held-out family replication for transfer claims
synthesis.multi_method_rule: If multiple methods/processes can interact, use factorial/subset interventions or another explicit interaction-aware design. A Shapley-style allocation may distribute an observed joint effect but must not be promoted to causal proof unless the underlying interventions/identification assumptions already support that claim.
synthesis.transfer_rule: Causal credit at one exact task/runtime identity does not establish method transfer validity on held-out families.

architecture_delta.recommended_next_gate: Add a separate provenance-bound controlled-ablation evidence/receipt layer downstream of WP305 before any component is promoted from PROCESSING_CREDIT_CANDIDATE to CAUSAL_METHOD_CREDIT.
do_not_do: do not turn a positive pairwise delta into fact/method authority
do not treat repeated correlation as independent causal replication
do not allocate interaction effects to one method without explicit intervention design
do not use causal credit to bypass capability/effect/completion gates

falsifiers: If current main already contains accepted controlled lesion/rescue or exact deterministic counterfactual receipts that bind intervention, nuisance controls and held-out transfer tests, this proposed next gate is already closed and must not be duplicated.

If an accepted threat/evidence model explicitly limits WP305 to deterministic local descriptive comparison forever, no causal-promotion layer is required for WP305 itself; it belongs only in a downstream method-learning authority.
